name: reapply_selected_object_position

stack.evidence: func_001D53A8 does not access or change the Script value stack

notes: func_001D53A8 copies the selected object's cached position vector at offsets 0x50 through 0x58 into a type-3 SET_POS operation addressed to that same object. The object-operation dispatcher reapplies the vector through func_00123E48, preserving the current facing angle while rebuilding position-dependent state. All 21 JP calls occur in lm03.ard, immediately follow command 13 set_object_animation, and immediately precede command 25 enable_selected_object_collision.
